groups.name: Subband Split
groups.description: Splits the spectrogram features into N non-overlapping frequency subbands and stacks them in the batch dimension.

groups.name: Shared Subband Encoder
groups.description: The same encoder (Q-blocks) processes every subband; the result is unstacked back to B x N.

groups.name: Frequency Pooling
groups.description: Average of mean- and max-pooling over the frequency axis.

groups.name: Subband Fusion
groups.description: Concatenates the subbands' channels and fuses them into one sequence.

groups.name: Temporal Pooling
groups.description: Average of mean- and max-pooling over time.
